skills.detail:
A close-range area attack with a Knockback effect.
Continues to push away enemies within a certain area at close-range while the skill button is held down.
Reduces damage taken and reduces chance of getting pushed away when attacked by enemy while the skill is active.

Deals a mid-range area attack with a Knockback effect after a certain period of time or when the skill button is released.
Adds the amount of reduced damage received from enemies while the skill is active to the damage dealt to enemies.
However, any damage reduced by Trait effects will not be added.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
skills.name: Guard Point

skills.detail:
When "Kung Fu Point" is used, Skill 2 will transform into the Combo Skill "Wa-cha!!!" for a set period of time.
Skill 2 turns back into "Kung Fu Point" after "Wa-cha!!!" is used or after a certain amount of time passes.

Moves towards enemies at long-range and attacks multiple times with a Knockback effect.
Increases own SPD.
Damage dealt will be based on your DEF instead of your ATK.
Damage dealt will disregard damage reduction.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
skills.name: Kung Fu Point
